title: Selected challenges
note: Hand-picked from the wall sample for variety and legibility. Not a benchmark.

E.name: Exact
E.meaning: The item is relevant for the query, and satisfies all the query specifications.

S.name: Substitute
S.meaning: The item is somewhat relevant: it fails to fulfill some aspects of the query but the item can be used as a functional substitute.

C.name: Complement
C.meaning: The item does not fulfill the query, but could be used in combination with an exact item.

I.name: Irrelevant
I.meaning: The item is irrelevant, or it fails to fulfill a central aspect of the query.

meta.precomputed: Model scores, BM25 scores, feature values and rankings were computed offline by pipeline/run.py. The browser recomputes recommend/pass decisions, every count, feature contributions and the receipt.

features.name: title_coverage
features.description: Share of the shopper's words found in the title

features.name: rare_word_coverage
features.description: The same share, weighted so rarer words count more

features.name: phrase_match
features.description: The whole query appears in the title, in order

features.name: word_pair_coverage
features.description: Share of adjacent word pairs from the query found in the title

features.name: numbers_matched
features.description: Share of the query's numbers found in the title

features.name: numbers_missing
features.description: Share of the query's numbers absent from the title

features.name: units_matched
features.description: Share of number+unit pairs (16 oz, 2 pack) found in the title

features.name: units_conflict
features.description: Share of number+unit pairs where the title has that unit with a different number

features.name: brand_in_query
features.description: The listing's brand is named in the query

features.name: colour_in_query
features.description: The listing's colour is named in the query

features.name: early_match
features.description: How near the front of the title the first shared word sits

features.name: query_length
features.description: Query length (log of word count); the same for every candidate of a query
